Asks a language model, with your own key, for each item or once for all of them: a prompt with expressions, the answer as text or as JSON in the shape you give, added to the item with the tokens it took. Calls are billed to the key's account.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `ai.agent` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Key (`credential`) | one of your credentials: [Anthropic API key](/docs/reference/credential-types/#anthropic-api-key) or [OpenAI-compatible API key](/docs/reference/credential-types/#openai-compatible-api-key) or [Google Gemini API key](/docs/reference/credential-types/#google-gemini-api-key) | yes |  | Your Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible or Gemini key, from the Credentials page. Personal: sharing the workflow leaves it out. |
| Model (`model`) | text | yes |  | As the provider names it, like claude-opus-5-5: one the key can use, or any other. |
| Call (`call`) | text | no | `each` | each: a call per item, the answer added to it. together: one call for all of them, and one item out, the answer alone. One of `each`, `together`. |
| System prompt (`system`) | text | no |  | How the model should go about it, like You are a careful prediction market analyst. |
| Prompt (`prompt`) | text | yes |  | What to ask, like Is {{ question }} worth watching? Taking them together, {{ items }} are all of them. |
| Include the items (`include`) | true or false | no | `true` | Taking them together: the items go after the prompt, as JSON. |
| Answer as (`answerAs`) | text | no | `text` | text as it is written; fields, the Fields below; schema, the JSON schema below. One of `text`, `fields`, `schema`. |
| Fields (`fields`) | table, its columns below | no |  | Answering in fields: a row each, like watch, true or false. |
| JSON schema (`schema`) | text | no |  | Answering to a schema: the answer's, for nested shapes. Claude wants additionalProperties false on every object. |
| Answer field (`field`) | text | no | `answer` | Where the answer goes on the item. |
| Max tokens (`maxTokens`) | whole number | no | `16000` | The most an answer may take, thinking included: one cut off fails. |
| Temperature (`temperature`) | number | no |  | Empty for the model's own; the newest Claude models take none. |
| Effort (`effort`) | text | no |  | How hard the model thinks first; empty for its own. One of `low`, `medium`, `high`. |
| Retries (`retries`) | whole number | no | `1` | How many more times to ask when an answer does not fit, up to 3; each is billed. |

### Fields columns

Each row of **Fields** has these cells. Only the whole table takes an [expression](/docs/guides/expressions/), not its cells.

| Column | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name (`name`) | text | yes |  | Like watch or reason: letters, digits and _. |
| Type (`type`) | text | no | `text` | One of `text`, `number`, `whole number`, `true or false`, `list of text`. |
| Description (`description`) | text | no |  | What it is, for the model: it reads this. |
| One of (`oneOf`) | text | no |  | For text: the answers allowed, separated by commas, like buy, sell, wait. |
| Optional (`optional`) | true or false | no | `false` | The model may leave it out, as null. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added, `answer` under the name **Answer field** (`field`) gives; with **Call** (`call`) `together`, one item instead, with only these. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `answer` | object | What the model answered. |
| `answer.text` | text; not always there | The answer as the model wrote it, answering as text. |
| `answer.json` | anything; not always there | The answer as JSON, answering in fields or to a schema. |
| `answer.model` | text | The model that answered, as the provider names it. |
| `answer.stopReason` | text | Why the model stopped, as the provider says: end_turn, stop, STOP and the like. |
| `answer.usage` | object | The tokens it took, every try counted. |
| `answer.usage.input` | number | Tokens in. |
| `answer.usage.output` | number | Tokens out, thinking included. |
| `answer.cost` | decimal; or null | What the provider says the calls cost, in dollars, when it says (OpenRouter). |
| `answer.tries` | number | How many calls it took: 1 unless an answer did not fit. |
